title: Tōkai Power Station
scope: The early exterior silhouette of the original Tōkai Power Station in Ibaraki, with the block-shaped main hall, long adjoining industrial hall and banded 89 m chimney seen in the Department of Energy archival photograph.
limitations: The archival photograph is undated. The selected January 1967 viewing date represents the early standalone appearance after the July 1966 opening. The viewing range ends before construction of the neighboring second station.

The named main envelope and historic chimney height are documented. Chimney and annex placement, roof heights, clerestories and the silhouette of the long hall are interpreted from the public aerial photograph. This edition covers the historic exterior buildings.
